purpose: Defines the production boundary between commerce, payment verification and student entitlement.
rules: A client-side success state must never be treated as proof of payment.
Enrollment becomes active only after server-side payment verification or an authorized manual enrollment action.
Lesson/content access must be authorized server-side.
Progress must be persisted server-side for authenticated students.
Refund/cancellation must revoke or suspend entitlement according to policy.
